name: sap-s4hana-cloud
description: Work with business partners, products, sales and purchase orders, supplier invoices, and journal entry items in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

SAP_S4HANA_API_HOST.title: API host
SAP_S4HANA_API_HOST.description: The tenant's OData API host, such as my123456-api.s4hana.cloud. Take it from the communication arrangement, not the Fiori launchpad host.

SAP_S4HANA_USERNAME.title: Communication user name
SAP_S4HANA_USERNAME.description: The communication user of an inbound communication arrangement that exposes the OData services, not a business user.
